name: alert
title: Alert
description: Accessible message container covering every UDesign semantic tone.
docs: An Alert is part of the page and is not a live region: a notice shown with the page is met in reading order. Pass live (role="status") when its appearance is the news, such as a result, or live="assertive" (role="alert") for an error that stops the work. An explicit role wins. See DESIGN.md "Feedback primitives".
